record.question: The baby that is least vulnerable to develop vitamin K bleeding tendency is
options: a three-day old neonate of a healthy mother that started immediate breastfeeding after birth
a three-year old child spent 21 days in intensive care unit receiving total parenteral nutrition
a nine-month-old infant with prolonged history of diarrhea and multiple antibiotics therapy
a six-hour neonate of an epileptic mother that received phenobarbital during pregnancy
